questions.question: Light rays enter the eye through the outer, transparent structure at the front of the eye called the __________.
questions.solution:
__**Concept:**__

__
 
• **Cornea: **It is the transparent front part of the eye that covers the iris, pupil, and anterior chamber. The cornea, with the anterior chamber and lens, refracts light.
 
• **Optical Nerve**: The optic nerve connects the eye to the brain. The optic nerve carries the impulses which are formed by the retina.
 
• **Iris**: The iris is a thin, circular structure in the eye, responsible for controlling the diameter and size of the pupil and thus the amount of light reaching the retina. Eye colour is defined by that of the iris.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ab0ae76cdf1612f33c129a616a40343105045de0698905bece80fe8f1f98bff8.png]

questions.question: The quorum to constitute a sitting of the Lok Sabha is ______ of the total number of Members of the House under article 100(3) of the Constitution of India.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is option 3 i.e. __**one-tenth.**__

**Article 100 gives the following powers Voting in Houses, power of Houses to act notwithstanding vacancies and quorum:**

 
• **​All questions **at any sitting of either House or joint sitting of the Houses shall be **determined by a majority of votes of the members present and voting,** other than the Speaker or person acting as Chairman or Speaker The Chairman or Speaker
 
• Either House of Parliament shall have the power to act notwithstanding any vacancy in the membership and any proceedings in Parliament shall be valid notwithstanding that it is discovered subsequently that some person who was not entitled so to do sat or voted or otherwise took part in the proceedings.
 
• **The quorum to constitute a meeting of either House of Parliament **shall be **one-tenth of the total number of members of the House.**
 
• If at any time **during a meeting of a House there is no quorum,** it shall be the **duty of the chairman or Speaker,** or person acting as such, either **to adjourn the House or to suspend the meeting until there is a quorum**

questions.question: What is the present Statutory Liquidity Ratio (SLR) announced by the Reserve Bank of India with effect from 1st January 2019?
questions.solution:
Note: At Present the correct rates are:

 
 

 __**Name of the monetary instrument **__
 __**Present rates**__
 
 

 Repo Rate
 5.15%
 
 

 Reverse Rep Rate
 4.90%
 
 

 MSF (Marginal Standing Facility)
 5.40%
 
 

 Bank Rate
 5.40%
 
 

 SLR (Statutory Liquidity Ratio)
 18.50%
 
 

 CRR (Cash Reserve Ratio)
 4%
 
 

The correct answer is option 2 i.e __**19.50%**__

**Statutory Liquidity Ratio:** 

 
• The share of NDTL that a bank is required to maintain in safe and liquid assets, such as unencumbered government securities, cash, and gold.
 
• Changes in SLR often influence the availability of resources in the banking system for lending to the private sector.
 
• The SLR is determined as a percentage of total demand and time liabilities.
 
• RBI used SLR to control inflation and fuel growth, by decreasing or increasing the money supply.

**How SLR is used to control Inflation**

 
• If RBI increases the SLR Rate then the bank has to hold more money, so the lending capacity of the bank decreases and the flow of money in the market decreases which means people have less money to spend which means demand decreases and hence inflation decreases.
 
• IF RBI decreases the SLR Rate then the bank has to hold less money. So the lending capacity of the bank increases and the flow of money in the market increases which means people have more money to spend and hence demand increases and hence inflation increases.
